iWant: each symbol implementing a touched criterion stubbed to throw, made a no-op and its calls removed, with the criterion's bound tests run against each
soThat: a criterion whose tests stay green against broken code is reported vacuous before Finalise
title: The verifier runs the mutation proof over the Code Node symbols of each touched criterion

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given a fixture whose AC-101-1 is bound to a test that asserts only that the CLI exits 0, and whose Code Node src/audit.js#writeAudit is called once per run but its output is never asserted, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then it exits 4 with "AC-101-1 vacuous: noOp on src/audit.js#writeAudit survived 1 bound tests" (and the same for callRemoval), and --json lists those mutants with result "survived".

[failure] Given AC-101-2 with no Code Node, AC-101-3 whose only Code Node is file-level (src/x.js with no #symbol) and AC-101-4 with no bound test case, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-2,AC-101-3,AC-101-4 runs, then it exits 4 with "AC-101-2 no Code Node", "AC-101-3 no symbol-level Code Node" and "AC-101-4 unbound".

[edge] Given a symbol whose no-op mutant makes its bound test hang past --mutant-timeout 5, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 --mutant-timeout 5 runs, then that mutant is recorded result "timeout", counts as killed, and the PASS line reports it under timeout; a symbol with no statement-level call site records callRemoval as "notApplicable" and the criterion still passes on its other two operators.

[must-not] rcf audit test-strength never mutates the working tree and never mutates a symbol of an untouched criterion: over a fixture whose FBS-001 scopes AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and whose REVIEW verdict touches only AC-101-1, a run with no --acs applies mutants only to AC-101-1's symbols, git status --porcelain and every tracked file's hash are unchanged after the run, and no scratch worktree is left registered (git worktree list shows only the main one).

[failure] Given a scope whose Code Node symbols would yield 240 mutants, when rcf audit test-strength runs with the default --max-mutants, then it exits 2 before running any test with stderr "test-strength: 240 mutants exceed --max-mutants 200; narrow the scope"; with --max-mutants 300 it runs.

[non-functional] Given a fixture round touching 8 criteria with 2 symbol-level Code Nodes each (48 mutants, the redesign's heavy round of 8 touched criteria in a 152-criterion spec) and bound test files that each run in about 2 seconds, when rcf audit test-strength runs with --jobs 4 on a 4-core CI-class runner, then it finishes within 5 minutes, runs only the 8 criteria's bound test files (never the whole suite), and the json totals report mutants 48 and the wall time in wallMs.
